messages.content: Make the canvas game use a purple background and cyan player.

Done. Replace the drawing colors with `ctx.fillStyle='#24113f'; ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height); ctx.fillStyle='#22d3ee'; ctx.fillRect(player.x,player.y,player.w,player.h);`. Keep the update loop unchanged so movement remains runnable.
Slow the falling obstacles to make the game easier.

Set one source of truth: `const FALL_SPEED=2.5;`. In `updateObstacle`, use `obstacle.y += FALL_SPEED;`; remove the old literal increment. The complete loop still calls update, collision, and render each frame.
Change the layout so the game is centered in a card.

Wrap the canvas in `

Dodge

`, then add `body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#111827}.card{padding:24px;border-radius:16px;background:#1f2937}`. The existing canvas script remains runnable.
Add keyboard controls and show which keys work.

Use `const keys=new Set(); addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight'].includes(e.key)){keys.add(e.key);e.preventDefault()}}); addEventListener('keyup',e=>keys.delete(e.key));` and in update apply `player.x += (keys.has('ArrowRight')-keys.has('ArrowLeft'))*5;`. Render `

Move: ← →

` beside the canvas.
Add a visible score that increases when an obstacle is dodged.

Initialize `let score=0;`. When removing an obstacle after `obstacle.y>canvas.height`, increment `score++`. Add `<output id="score">Score: 0</output>` and update it each frame with `scoreEl.textContent=`Score: ${score}``. This preserves the existing collision behavior.
Store the best score between page loads.

Add `const bestKey='dodge-best'; let best=Number(localStorage.getItem(bestKey)||0);`. On game over, use `if(score>best){best=score;localStorage.setItem(bestKey,String(best));}` and render `Score: ${score} · Best: ${best}`. Guard storage with try/catch if private browsing is a target.
Add a restart button after game over.

Add `<button id="restart" hidden>Restart</button>`. In `endGame`, set `gameOver=true; restart.hidden=false;`. Register `restart.onclick=()=>{score=0; obstacles.length=0; player.x=canvas.width/2; gameOver=false; restart.hidden=true; requestAnimationFrame(loop);}`. The button now resets all mutable state.
Make the controls usable on mobile with left and right buttons.

Add `
`. Track `let touchDir=0; document.querySelectorAll('[data-dir]').forEach(b=>{b.onpointerdown=()=>touchDir=Number(b.dataset.dir);b.onpointerup=()=>touchDir=0;b.onpointerleave=()=>touchDir=0});` and use `(touchDir||keyboardDir)` in update.
Revise the previous speed change so the difficulty ramps up every ten points.

Keep `const BASE_SPEED=2.5;` and compute `const fallSpeed=BASE_SPEED+Math.floor(score/10)*0.5;`. Replace the obstacle increment with `obstacle.y += fallSpeed;`. This revises the prior fixed speed while keeping score-driven progression deterministic.
Add a pause control without breaking the animation loop.

Use `let paused=false;` and a button `<button id="pause">Pause</button>`. Its handler toggles `paused` and label text. In `loop(time)`, call physics and collision only when `!paused`, always render, then call `requestAnimationFrame(loop)`. This keeps the loop alive while gameplay pauses.
Change the player layout from a rectangle to a circle.

Replace player rendering with `ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(player.x,player.y,player.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();`. Set `const player={x:canvas.width/2,y:280,r:14};`. For simple collision, compare obstacle bounds against `player.x±player.r` and `player.y±player.r`; all coordinates remain canvas-local.
Add a mute button for sound effects.

Add `<button id="mute" aria-pressed="false">Sound on</button>` and `let muted=false; mute.onclick=()=>{muted=!muted;mute.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(muted));mute.textContent=muted?'Sound off':'Sound on';};`. Wrap each effect call as `if(!muted) playDodgeSound();`; no audio is required for the game to run.
Make the canvas responsive while preserving its internal physics size.

Keep `canvas.width=480` and `canvas.height=320`, then add CSS `canvas{display:block;width:min(92vw,480px);height:auto}`. Do not use CSS dimensions in collision math; pointer or touch coordinates should be scaled by `canvas.width/canvas.getBoundingClientRect().width` when needed.
Revise the controls to support WASD as well as arrows and prevent stuck keys.

Define `const left=new Set(['ArrowLeft','a','A']),right=new Set(['ArrowRight','d','D']);` and use `keydown`/`keyup` to maintain a `Set` of active keys. Add `addEventListener('blur',()=>active.clear());` so focus loss releases every key. Compute direction from membership in the two sets.
Add a compact storage button that exports the current score as JSON.

Add `<button id="save">Save score</button>` and handler `save.onclick=()=>{const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify({score,best,created:new Date().toISOString()})],{type:'application/json'});const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);a.download='dodge-score.json';a.click();URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);};`. It works without a server and leaves gameplay untouched.
